"""RR IPL 2027 auction plan: six slots, each with a ladder of options (A -> B -> C ...), walk-away caps, likely rivals and
when to switch. Numbers come from auction_scores.csv (IPL lens), auction_t20i.csv (T20I lens), fin2 pressure ratings and
rivals2027.csv. Caps are our recommendation from need priority and 2026 contract anchors, not price predictions.
Ages are approximate, at the 2027 season."""
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, pathlib
W = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/work"); O = pathlib.Path("/home/claude/dash7"); O.mkdir(exist_ok=True); CODE = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()
S = pd.read_csv(W / "auction_scores.csv"); T = pd.read_csv(W / "auction_t20i.csv"); R = pd.read_csv(W / "rivals2027.csv")
rb = pd.read_csv(W / "fin2_ratings_bat.csv", index_col=0); rw = pd.read_csv(W / "fin2_ratings_bowl.csv", index_col=0)
rb["prank"] = range(1, len(rb) + 1); rw["prank"] = range(1, len(rw) + 1)
AGE = {"Trent Boult": 37, "Matheesha Pathirana": 24, "Gerald Coetzee": 26, "Mustafizur Rahman": 31, "Taskin Ahmed": 31, "Glenn Maxwell": 38, "Kamindu Mendis": 28,
       "Jacob Bethell": 23, "M Shahrukh Khan": 31, "Nitish Rana": 33, "Abhinav Manohar": 32, "Avesh Khan": 30, "Mohit Sharma": 38, "Jaydev Unadkat": 35,
       "Deepak Chahar": 34, "Mayank Markande": 29, "Maheesh Theekshana": 26, "Moeen Ali": 39, "Akash Madhwal": 33, "Akash Deep": 30}
PRICE26 = {"Trent Boult": 12.5, "Matheesha Pathirana": 18, "Avesh Khan": 9.75, "Shimron Hetmyer": 11}
PLAN = [  # slot, need, fixes, cap, overseas, [(option, player, lens need, why, switch when)]
 (1, "Overseas pacer for the death and the new ball", "W1, W2, W3, W5", 10.0, True, [
   ("A", "Trent Boult", "N3", "Best available at both: +3.09 at the death and +2.14 with the new ball (248 IPL balls). Covers two moments with one overseas slot.", "Price passes 10 cr, or Lucknow and Mumbai both stay in past 8 cr"),
   ("B", "Matheesha Pathirana", "N3", "Pressure rank 13 of all bowlers; 260 IPL death balls at economy 8.9. Death only, so new ball then comes from slot 4.", "Price passes 9 cr"),
   ("C", "Gerald Coetzee", "N3", "Above the league at the death in both IPL (+1.29) and T20Is (+1.20); 26 years old.", "Price passes 6 cr"),
   ("D", "Mustafizur Rahman", "N5", "Pressure rank 9; +1.84 with the new ball. Bid only once his availability for IPL 2027 is confirmed.", "Availability not confirmed")]),
 (2, "Overseas finisher against right-arm pace", "B1, B2", 6.0, True, [
   ("A", "Glenn Maxwell", "N1", "T20I death v right-arm pace: strike rate 193, out every 34 balls (+14.7); batting pressure rank 13. Bowls off-spin to left-handers (W4). Only if he registers; age 38.", "Not registered, or price passes 6 cr"),
   ("B", "Kamindu Mendis", "N1", "Left-hander (fixes the left-handed No. 5-7 gap): T20I strike rate 186 at the death v right-arm pace (+4.7). Also bowls.", "Price passes 5 cr"),
   ("C", "Jacob Bethell", "N1", "Left-hander, 23: T20I strike rate 184 in the same spot (+2.0). Also left-arm finger spin.", "Price passes 4 cr")]),
 (3, "Indian finisher", "B1, B2, B3", 4.0, False, [
   ("A", "M Shahrukh Khan", "N1", "Best Indian finisher in the pool: +3.02 at the death v right-arm pace, strike rate 176 (99 IPL balls). Keeps an overseas slot free.", "Price passes 4 cr"),
   ("B", "Nitish Rana", "N1", "Strike rate 235 in the same spot, but only 22 balls; bowls off-spin.", "Price passes 3 cr"),
   ("C", "Abhinav Manohar", "N1", "Slightly above the league (+0.23, 35 balls); cheap.", "Price passes 1 cr")]),
 (4, "Indian death pacer (replaces Tushar Deshpande)", "W1, W2, W3", 4.5, False, [
   ("A", "Avesh Khan", "N3", "+2.25 at the death on 211 IPL balls, economy 9.2. Weak with the new ball, so death only.", "Price passes 4.5 cr"),
   ("B", "Mohit Sharma", "N3", "181 IPL death balls at economy 10.0, just above the league (+0.27); age 38, so one season.", "Price passes 2 cr"),
   ("B'", "Deepak Chahar", "N5", "Take him instead of Mohit if slot 1 ended with a death-only bowler: 245 new-ball balls, +0.46.", "Price passes 2.5 cr"),
   ("C", "Jaydev Unadkat", "N3", "Left-arm angle at the death, economy 9.45.", "Price passes 1.5 cr")]),
 (5, "Middle-overs spinner against left-handed No. 3-4", "W4", 1.5, False, [
   ("A", "Mayank Markande", "N4", "Best available against left-handed No. 3-4 in overs 7-15: +2.87, economy 9.3.", "Price passes 1.5 cr"),
   ("B", "Maheesh Theekshana", "N4", "Off-spin, economy 6.8 to left-handed No. 3-4. Uses the third overseas slot, so only if slot 2 went to an Indian.", "No overseas slot left"),
   ("C", "Moeen Ali", "N4", "Off-spin, economy 6.7 in the same spot; age 39.", "Price passes 1 cr")]),
 (6, "Back-up new-ball pacer", "W5", 0.75, False, [
   ("A", "Akash Madhwal", "N5", "+3.57 with the new ball (economy 6.7) on a small sample; poor at the death, so new ball only.", "Price passes 0.75 cr"),
   ("B", "Akash Deep", "N5", "New ball +0.66, economy 10.4.", "Price passes 0.5 cr"),
   ("C", "Best uncapped pacer in the final register (3 Dec)", "N5", "The data pack has too few IPL balls for uncapped players to rank them; scout the register.", "")]),
]
OVS = set(S[S.overseas].name) | {"Glenn Maxwell", "Kamindu Mendis", "Jacob Bethell", "Taskin Ahmed", "Maheesh Theekshana", "Moeen Ali"}
NEEDROLE = {"N1": "compete_N1", "N3": "compete_N3", "N5": "compete_N5", "N4": "compete_N4"}
rows = []
for slot, need, fixes, cap, ovs, opts in PLAN:
    for opt, nm, nd, why, sw in opts:
        x = S[(S.name == nm) & (S.need == nd)]; y = T[(T.name == nm) & (T.need == nd)]
        st = S[S.name == nm].status; st = st.iat[0] if len(st) else (T[T.name == nm].status.iat[0] if len(T[T.name == nm]) else "In the 3 Dec register")
        rk = (rb if nd in ("N1",) else rw); pr = rk[rk.name == nm].prank
        overseas = nm in OVS
        riv = R[(R[NEEDROLE[nd]] >= 0.15) & (R.team != "Rajasthan Royals") & ((R.overseas_slots > 0) if overseas else True)].sort_values(NEEDROLE[nd], ascending=False).team.tolist()
        rows.append({"slot": slot, "need": need, "fixes": fixes, "slot_cap_cr": cap, "option": opt, "player": nm, "overseas": "Overseas" if overseas else "Indian",
                     "age": AGE.get(nm), "status": st, "ipl_balls": int(x.balls.iat[0]) if len(x) else None, "ipl_value": round(x.value.iat[0], 2) if len(x) else None,
                     "ipl_stat": round(x.stat1.iat[0], 1) if len(x) else None, "t20i_value": round(y.t20i_value.iat[0], 2) if len(y) else None,
                     "t20i_stat": round(y.t20i_stat1.iat[0], 1) if len(y) else None, "pressure_rank": int(pr.iat[0]) if len(pr) else None,
                     "price_2026_cr": PRICE26.get(nm), "likely_rivals": ", ".join(t.replace("Royal Challengers Bengaluru", "RCB") for t in riv[:3]) or "Few",
                     "why": why, "switch_when": sw, "stat_label": "Strike rate" if nd == "N1" else "Economy"})
P = pd.DataFrame(rows); P.to_csv(W / "auction_plan.csv", index=False)
cov = pd.read_csv(W / "rr27_coverage.csv")
NEEDN = {"N1": "Finisher v right-arm pace at the death", "N2": "Lower-order hitting, No. 8-11, overs 19-20", "N3": "Death bowler, overs 16-18",
         "N4": "Middle-overs bowler v left-handed No. 3-4", "N5": "New-ball wicket-taker v right-handed openers"}
C = []
for nd, lab in NEEDN.items():
    c = cov[(cov.need == nd) & (cov.balls >= 20)].sort_values("value", ascending=False)
    best = c.head(1)
    C.append({"need": lab, "rr_players_above_league": ", ".join(c[c.value > 0].name) or "None",
              "rr_players_below_league": ", ".join(c[c.value <= 0].name) or "None",
              "still_open": "Yes" if (c.value > 0).sum() < 2 else "Partly"})
C = pd.DataFrame(C); C.to_csv(W / "rr27_needs.csv", index=False)
def dump(name, df, inputs):
    rws = json.loads(df.replace({np.nan: None}).to_json(orient="records"))
    (O / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"rows": rws, "meta": [{"label": "s35_plan.py", "value": CODE, "type": "code", "lang": "python"}, {"label": "Input", "value": inputs}]}))
    print(name, len(rws))
dump("auction_plan", P, "auction_scores.csv, auction_t20i.csv, fin2 ratings, rivals2027.csv")
Rv = R.copy(); Rv["team"] = Rv.team
dump("rivals", Rv, "rivals2027.csv (s34_rivals.py); purses: Business Standard, 17 Nov 2026")
dump("rr27_needs", C, "rr27_coverage.csv (s32_auction.py)")
av = S[S.status.str.startswith(("Released", "Not in")) & S.active_2026 & (S.balls >= 20)].copy()
av["need_label"] = av.need.map(NEEDN); av = av.round(2)
dump("pool_scores", av[["need", "need_label", "name", "country", "overseas", "status", "balls", "value", "stat1", "stat2", "bowler_type", "hand", "note"]], "auction_scores.csv (s32_auction.py)")
pd.set_option("display.width", 300); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 60)
print(P[["slot", "option", "player", "status", "ipl_value", "t20i_value", "pressure_rank", "likely_rivals"]].to_string(index=False)); print(C.to_string(index=False))
